post.caption: A gold horse puzzle was solved late. A 1984 book and video hid clues to a buried gold horse. It was built as America's answer to Masquerade. The horse was about one kilogram of gold. Its hollow belly held a key to a safe deposit box. The deadline was midnight on May 26, 1989, and nobody solved it. The promoters dug it up and gave the prize to charity. Months later, two men solved the puzzle anyway. They dug at Tennessee Pass in Colorado and found a vial. Its note began by congratulating them. The pass sits beside the Continental Divide.
